column1: Toss the eggplant pieces in a bowl with the salt and pepper.
Add the thyme, oregano, garlic, balsamic and olive oil and toss well to coat. Marinate 10 minutes, tossing again halfway. Keep the bowl and marinade.
Stand the eggplant skin-side down on the grill first, then turn every 3 minutes or so until every side has been grilled.
Keep grilling until the pieces are charred and so soft they nearly fall apart.
Return the eggplant to the marinade, let it soak and cool for 5 minutes, then serve.
